chunks: 4880 - And in the narration of Ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"A sick man does not have the right to divorce his wife, but he may marry."

key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: the narrator Zurārah in the chain of transmission
key_terms.ٱلْمَرِيضِ: a sick person; here, a man in illness

ai.seo_question: Can a sick man divorce his wife in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the marital actions of a sick man. It states that he may not divorce his wife in that condition, while marriage remains permitted to him.
